title: Handle red-side first pick in pro data
description: Pro play can now grant first pick to Red side. Verify raw data semantics and update processing/model assumptions to handle Red-first drafts correctly.
notes: Validated against freshly downloaded 2025/2026 Oracle files (download-cron -> /tmp/prodata-latest, processor -> /tmp/prodata-processed-latest). Processed teams output includes firstpick column with binary values (0/1) and 363 red-side first-pick rows; 360 valid red-first games identified. DraftDataset first-pick ordering validation passed for 40 sampled games (20 red-first + 20 blue-first) and full sweep passed for 357/357 clean red-first games (3 excluded due duplicate champs that dataset intentionally skips).
close_reason: Implemented firstpick support and validated red-side first-pick ordering on latest downloaded real data.
